description:
IT Technician - Florești

Our company is looking for a passionate and dedicated IT Technician to join our team in Florești. If you are a proactive person with strong technical skills and a positive attitude, this position could be a good fit for you.

Responsabilities:

 -     Provide Technical Support service for users to ensure business objectives.

-      Perform IMAC (install, move, add, change) activities for Microsoft products.

-       Preparing documentation for technical solution implemented.

-     Perform on-site activities.

-     Configuration and maintenance of printers, video projectors, display-wall systems.

-     Approaches and solves requests arrived via the dedicated support channels.

-     Build, assimilate, implement, audit and improve working procedures.

-     Communicating with Customers via phone, email or Zoom/WebEx/Teams.

-     Act as Internal IT support person.

-     Management of hardware equipment under official maintenance of the vendor

-     Give feedback to customers on incidents.

-     Providing Level 1, Level 2 and Customer Liaison support as required.

-     Retrieve all necessary information for further investigations.

 Skills and Experience:

 -        Excellent knowledge of the main client operating systems (Windows10, Windows11) and of the main troubleshooting techniques

-        Experience with ticketing systems.

-        Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

-        MAC OS and Android concept knowledge.

-        Previous experience in similar job is a plus.

-          Ability to operate well in an international and multicultural environment.

-          Innovative and entrepreneurial mindset.

-          Well organized, able to set priorities.

-          Dynamic and good communications skills.

-          English language.

If you are passionate about technology and looking for a new professional challenge, apply now for the IT Technician position in Florești and join our team!
